purpose: Third external-source replay slice extending the forensic test set into a modern head-of-government assassination chart with a strong same-day event-time anchor

cases.title: Assassination of Shinzo Abe
cases.source_title: The Asahi Shimbun report on the shooting of former Prime Minister Shinzo Abe in Nara
cases.source_metadata_note: The same-day Asahi report says two shots were heard while Abe was giving a speech in front of Yamato-Saidaiji Station in Nara at around 11:30 a.m. on July 8, 2022. That is a strong public-event anchor for a modern political assassination chart.
